answer: Adopt a warm-up traffic gate: each new identity must wait a fixed warm-up and keep a low-rate message thread before its actions count. Enforcement splits each identity into its own timing island, so bursty traffic from fresh identities is throttled until the warm-up completes. An attacker pays real elapsed time plus bandwidth per identity, including a distinct umber schedule, making each sybil cost a separate wait and traffic-shape burden.
